jobs.title: HubSpot Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**Apply on Indeed or via our website:** https://www.marketveep.com/careers/fractional\-onboarding\-specialists

\* This is a fractional (part\-time) role. Hours are not guaranteed.

\-\-

Guide clients through HubSpot onboarding, set up their systems strategically, and ensure smooth project execution. Here’s what you’ll focus on:

* **HubSpot Onboarding Consultation**: Lead clients through the HubSpot onboarding process, guiding them step by step to ensure a smooth and efficient implementation of Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, and/or Service Hub.
* **Client HubSpot Training**: Host meetings to provide hands\-on training, share best practices, and give setup advice so clients can confidently use HubSpot for their business goals.
* **Project Management**: Ensure onboarding projects stay on schedule, within scope, and aligned with client expectations, coordinating closely with the production team for timely execution.
* **Client Satisfaction**: Monitor client progress and feedback throughout onboarding, proactively address concerns, and ensure deliverables meet standards—generating positive client reviews, testimonials, and overall satisfaction.

\-\-

**Your Professional Experience:**

* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with HubSpot, including Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, and/or Service Hub, with the ability to guide clients through setup and best practices.
* 2\+ years of agency experience
* Experience in client onboarding, customer success, or account management, preferably with SaaS or CRM platforms.
* Proven project management skills, with experience keeping projects on schedule, within scope, and aligned with client expectations.
* Strong client\-facing experience, including hosting meetings, providing training, and presenting technical concepts in an accessible way.
* Track record of driving client satisfaction, including gathering feedback, addressing concerns, and generating positive client reviews or testimonials.
* Excellent communication and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate across internal teams and manage multiple client projects simultaneously.

\-\-

**What You’re Obsessed With:**

* HubSpot mastery, staying up to date on features and best practices.
* Helping clients succeed and feel confident with new tools.
* Making complex software simple and understandable.
* Keeping projects organized, on time, and within scope.
* Providing clear, actionable guidance that drives results.
* Gathering feedback and turning it into positive client experiences.
* Collaborating with internal teams to deliver seamless onboarding.
* Seeing measurable impact from your work through client satisfaction and success.

\-\-

**A Day in the Life…**

Your day starts with reviewing ongoing client onboarding projects, checking progress, and ensuring everything is on track and within scope. You lead client meetings to provide training, share best practices, and offer setup guidance, helping clients feel confident using HubSpot’s Marketing, Sales, or Service Hub.

Throughout the day, you collaborate closely with the production team, making sure your recommendations are implemented smoothly, and coordinate with other internal teams to resolve any questions or challenges. You track project milestones, monitor client satisfaction, and gather feedback to ensure successful onboarding and generate positive reviews.

Your role is all about delivering exceptional client experiences, keeping projects on schedule, and helping clients get the most value from HubSpot.

\-\-

**Interview Process** 

1\. Introductory Chat (15 minutes)

2\. HubSpot Demo \& Team Interview (45–60 minutes)

3\. Reference Check \& Offer

\-\-

**The Future of Freelancing is Fractional** 

* Complete flexibility in when you work. No required hours or fixed schedule.
* Autonomy to manage your time in a way that fits your life and working style.
* Clear project\-based hour allocations that allow you to plan and prioritize with confidence.
* High\-trust environment with plenty of tools and resources to empower you to achieve successful outcomes.
* Client work is provided 100% post\-sale; no pitching, selling, or business development required.
* Remain an active member of our team between project assignments.
* Ability to focus on your craft and deliver great work without worrying about finding the next engagement.
* Collaborative team support without the constraints of a traditional full\-time role.
* A culture of teamwork and recognition that brings together diverse talent in a fun environment.

Pay: $50\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* The primary responsibilities of this role are hosting client meetings, providing customer service through email, and training clients on HubSpot tools. Does this align with your goals?
* What systems have you integrated with HubSpot, if any?

Experience:

* HubSpot: 5 years (Required)
* Marketing agency: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Safety & Training Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Safety \& Training Coordinator**
==================================


**Position Summary**
--------------------


The Safety \& Training Coordinator supports the company’s safety and compliance programs through administrative coordination, data management, training delivery, and documentation control. This role plays a key part in maintaining training records, ensuring regulatory compliance, supporting incident investigations, and conducting new hire orientation and safety presentations.  

  

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, comfortable with data entry systems, and confident presenting in front of large groups.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Training \& Orientation**


* Conduct new hire safety orientation and onboarding sessions.
* Present safety training programs to employees in classroom and group settings.
* Prepare training materials and assist with class setup and coordination.
* Schedule and track required online training programs.
* Maintain accurate training records and certifications.
* Ensure shop and mobile equipment training documentation is completed and uploaded properly.
* Assist in development and revision of safety procedures and site\-specific safety plans.

### **Data Entry \& Documentation Management**


* Scan, upload, and maintain training records in company systems (e.g., Quickbase, ISN, Avetta).
* Track and schedule client\-required online training.
* Upload Certificates of Insurance (COIs), policies, and client\-requested documentation.
* Track and calibrate air monitors and enter data into designated systems.
* Track Job Safety Analysis (JSA) completions and equipment inspections daily.
* Maintain electronic and physical safety files.
* Print and assemble foreman binders and training packets as needed.

### **Reporting \& Compliance Support**


* Conduct and document monthly fire extinguisher inspections.
* Assist with incident investigations, including documentation and report preparation.
* Ensure hazardous waste is properly labeled and coordinate disposal.
* Support safety reporting and documentation efforts.
* Assist with compliance tracking across multiple buildings or job sites.

### **Inventory \& Equipment Support**


* Monitor, stock, and issue Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
* Ensure documentation for equipment training (40\+ pieces of equipment) is properly completed and recorded.
* Assist with mobile and shop equipment training documentation.

**Minimum Requirements**
------------------------


* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* 1–3 years of experience in an administrative, safety, training, or compliance\-related role preferred.
* OSHA Construction 30 Hour
* Basic computer skills required.
* Strong data entry and document management skills.
* Experience using databases or tracking systems (Quickbase, ISN, Avetta, or similar platforms preferred).
* Experience training and presenting in front of large groups.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience in construction, industrial, or safety\-related environments.
* OSHA 500 Outreach Instructor
* Knowledge of OSHA documentation or compliance processes.
* Familiarity with safety training coordination.
* Experience assisting with incident investigations.


**Work Environment**
--------------------


Combination of office and shop/field environment.  

May require standing for extended periods during training sessions.  

Frequent interaction with employees at all levels of the organization.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
The **Implementation Specialist** is responsible for leading the successful onboarding and implementation of new and existing clients onto the Serve You Rx PBM platform. This role functions as the primary project manager during the implementation phase, ensuring accurate configuration, on\-time delivery, and a seamless transition to ongoing client support within the Client Success team.

  


**What You’ll Do:**

  


As the **Implementation Specialist**, you will:


* Lead end\-to\-end PBM implementations, including benefit configuration, eligibility setup, formulary alignment, and testing
* Serve as the primary project manager for assigned client implementations, managing timelines, milestones, and deliverables
* Act as the main point of contact for clients throughout the implementation process
* Partner closely with internal teams (Clinical, IT, Operations, Pharmacy, and Finance) to ensure accurate system setup
* Coordinate data exchanges such as eligibility files, accumulators, reporting requirements, and other client data needs
* Manage client communication strategies throughout implementation, including planning and execution of member disruption mitigation and notification efforts
* Request, review, and track appropriate use of historical claims files, prior authorization (PA) files, and ORFT data to support accurate implementation and transition activities
* Confirm member lettering requirements and facilitate required member communications in alignment with client expectations, regulatory standards, and PBM guidelines
* Proactively identify risks, resolve issues, and escalate concerns as appropriate
* Facilitate implementation meetings, status calls, and post\-implementation handoffs to account management
* Ensure all implementations meet PBM regulatory requirements and Serve You Rx standards
* Maintain clear documentation of client configurations, communication plans, and implementation workflows
* Contribute to process improvements and best practices within the Client Success department

  




**Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy, Healthcare Administration, Business, or a related field OR minimum of 5 years of PBM, TPA project management experience
* Preferably experience within a PBM, managed care, or pharmacy operations environment
* Demonstrated project management experience, including managing multiple concurrent implementations
* Strong knowledge of PBM and TPA operations, pharmacy benefits, claims processing, and eligibility management
* Excellent communication, organizational, and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment
* Prior PBM implementation or client onboarding experience preferred
* Project management certification (PMP, CAPM, or similar) preferred
* Experience working with employer groups, TPAs, brokers, or health plans preferred
* Familiarity with pharmacy benefit systems and data integrations preferred
* Deep knowledge of PBM operations and pharmacy benefit processes.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
* Strong organizational skills with ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
* Proficiency in MS Office/Outlook and ability to learn internal systems quickly.
* Ability to perform in a fast\-paced environment, respond under pressure, and handle escalations professionally.

  


**Why Serve You Rx?**

  


Serve You Rx is a full\-service pharmacy benefit manager (PBM) with unquestionable flexibility and an unwavering commitment to doing what's best for its clients. With a fervent focus on those it serves, including insurance brokers, consultants, third\-party administrators, and their clients, Serve You Rx delivers exceptional service and tailored, cost\-effective benefit solutions. Independent and privately held for nearly 40 years, Serve You Rx can implement new groups in 30 days or less and say "yes" to a wide variety of viable solutions. Known for its adaptability, quality, and client\-centricity, Serve You Rx aims to be a benchmark for better client service.

  


The company offers generous benefits to include: medical (HMO and PPO), dental, vision, 401k, HSA, identity theft and legal coverage, pet insurance, paid parental leave, and 18 days of paid time off in your first year.

jobs.title: Technical Application SME – Federal Health Information Systems
jobs.description:
**Company:** Native American Industrial Solutions LLC (NAIS)

**Location:** National Captial Region

**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**Position Status:** Contingent upon contract award

**Security Requirement:** Ability to obtain and maintain the required federal suitability determination, security clearance, and system access

**Position Overview**


NAIS is seeking a senior Technical Application Subject Matter Expert to support the sustainment, integration, and continued development of mission\-critical federal health information systems.


The Technical Application SME will provide senior technical leadership across application development, systems analysis, database technologies, data architecture, data warehousing, testing, networking, integration, and production support. The position will work closely with functional SMEs, government stakeholders, cybersecurity personnel, and multidisciplinary engineering teams.


This position is designated as Key Personnel. Employment is contingent upon contract award, customer approval, and successful completion of applicable security, suitability, and onboarding requirements.

**Responsibilities**

* Provide senior technical guidance for the sustainment and enhancement of enterprise health applications.
* Translate functional requirements into secure, supportable technical designs and implementation approaches.
* Advise teams on application architecture, software design, business logic, databases, data models, interfaces, and data\-processing workflows.
* Support requirements analysis, system design, development, integration, testing, deployment, and production\-readiness activities.
* Evaluate proposed technical changes for feasibility, interoperability, performance, security, maintainability, and operational risk.
* Guide integration among applications, databases, data repositories, analytical environments, external systems, and medical devices.
* Support database design, administration, engineering, performance optimization, backup, recovery, and continuity activities.
* Support data architecture, data\-warehouse management, data validation, transformation, reporting, and analytics.
* Advise on the integration of occupational and environmental health exposure information into enterprise data repositories.
* Support application and database troubleshooting, defect resolution, incident response, outage management, and production operations.
* Participate in technical reviews, code\-quality reviews, test planning, release\-readiness assessments, and risk\-management activities.
* Support interfaces that transmit clinical data from diagnostic equipment, including audiometers, into enterprise systems.
* Coordinate technical activities across developers, systems analysts, database personnel, data engineers, testers, network specialists, cybersecurity staff, and functional SMEs.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, architectural materials, interface specifications, data documentation, operating procedures, and decision records.
* Communicate technical risks, dependencies, alternatives, and recommendations to program leadership and government stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* Senior\-level experience supporting enterprise information technology or software\-development environments.
* Demonstrated experience in one or more relevant technical disciplines, such as application development, systems analysis, database administration, database engineering, data architecture, data warehousing, networking, or software testing.
* Knowledge of software\-development lifecycles, application functionality, business logic, databases, data processing, interfaces, integration, and production support.
* Experience analyzing complex technical problems and developing practical, supportable solutions.
* Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary software, data, infrastructure, cybersecurity, testing, and mission teams.
* Strong technical\-writing, documentation, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical matters to government leaders, mission users, and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Ability to satisfy applicable federal suitability, security\-clearance, system\-access, and onboarding requirements.

**Preferred Experience**

* Senior\-level experience supporting occupational and environmental health, military health, medical\-readiness, clinical, or comparable federal health systems.
* Knowledge of occupational and environmental health business practices and exposure information.
* Experience with the design, architecture, data models, and integration of defense health or exposure information.
* Experience supporting application development and systems analysis for mission\-critical enterprise systems.
* Experience as an Application Developer, Application Systems Analyst, Systems Analyst, Database Administrator, Database Engineer, Database Specialist, Data Architect, Data Warehouse Specialist, Network Specialist, or Test Engineer.
* Experience with relational databases, data repositories, data warehouses, ETL or ELT processes, reporting, analytics, and data\-quality controls.
* Experience with APIs, enterprise interfaces, interoperability, and secure data exchange.
* Experience integrating medical devices or diagnostic equipment with enterprise applications.
* Knowledge of protocols and data\-capture interfaces used to transmit clinical data from audiometers or comparable diagnostic equipment.
* Experience supporting development, test, staging, and production environments.
* Experience with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid software\-development methodologies.
* Experience supporting release management, configuration management, testing, defect resolution, deployment, and production operations.
* Experience working within Department of Defense or other federal information\-technology environments.

**Work Environment**


The place of performance is associated with Falls Church, Virginia. The final onsite, remote, or hybrid work arrangement will be determined by contract and customer requirements.


The position may require collaboration with geographically distributed government, military, clinical, cybersecurity, and engineering stakeholders. Occasional travel may be required based on final program needs.

**Application**


Please submit a résumé demonstrating senior\-level experience in applicable software\-development, systems\-analysis, database, data\-architecture, data\-warehouse, network, integration, or testing disciplines. Applicants should clearly identify their primary technical specialty and any relevant federal health, military health, medical\-device, or occupational and environmental health experience.


Candidates selected for proposal submission will be asked to provide a signed letter of intent or commitment and documentation needed to verify qualifications and security eligibility.


This position is contingent upon contract award, customer approval of Key Personnel, and successful completion of applicable federal security, suitability, and onboarding requirements.


NAIS is an equal opportunity employer.

*Alfa is looking to recruit a Senior Implementation Consultant to join our team.*

Key responsibilities:


*You will work as part of a larger team supporting a client implementation of Alfa Systems, reporting into the Alfa Project Manager or Alfa Implementation Architect. With the support of the Alfa team, you will contribute to a specific area of the client project such as:*

Business analysis, including:


* Requirements gathering and documentation of user stories; working closely with our customers and software engineering teams to identify gaps and ensure new features satisfy customer requirements
* Participating in process mapping workshops and process documentation, including operational processes with significant accounting, reporting and integration impacts
* Configuring Alfa Systems to support customer requirements and business processes
* Support of accounting and finance workshops

Application support, including:


* Defect investigation and triage, collaborating closely with our software engineering teams to ensure issues are resolved efficiently; performing QA and review of issues; understanding customer impacts and providing workarounds pending issue resolution
* Assisting our clients with ensuring test coverage and requirements traceability

Data conversion, including:


* Participating in data mapping workshops; transform and load development; data reconciliation and troubleshooting
* Data conversion execution during the go\-live event and prior dress rehearsals

Training, including development of Alfa Systems training materials and training delivery


*You will be expected to take ownership of your area and may be responsible for the supervision and support of more junior consultants working in that area. You will work closely with both the client and the rest of the implementation team to ensure the success of both your specific stream and the overall project:*

* Provide input into workstream and project planning
* Proactively identify risks \& issues that might impact delivery timelines
* Continue to learn about Alfa Systems and the industries we support, sharing this knowledge with the broader company
* Report on progress, work within timelines, and monitor budget for your area of responsibility
* Develop exceptional relationships with members of the customer and Alfa teams through tact and diplomacy

We would love you to have:


* Prior Business Analysis and/or Consultancy experience
* Knowledge or experience of software development life cycles (SDLC) and enterprise software implementation
* Proven problem solving abilities
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Preferred:


* Prior experience working on an Alfa implementation
* Experience in the auto finance/equipment finance field

What we’ll do for you

* Provide private health insurance
* Support you with enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave with family\-friendly policies
* Provide Income protection
* Provide Life, disability and worldwide travel insurance

We bring our industry\-leading software platform to the likes of Mercedes\-Benz and CarMax, so they can do business globally. jobs.title: RCM Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
Ensora Health is the leading provider of software and services for mental and behavioral health therapists, trusted by over 200,000 individual providers and more than 28,000 practices. Our unmatched expertise, partnership, and breadth of products allow us to fine\-tune solutions that meet the specific needs of everyone from solo practitioners to larger practices. With AI\-enabled solutions that span practice management to electronic medical records and e\-prescribing to billing, we help eliminate administrative complexity and create harmony between therapists, their clients, and the whole healthcare community.

**Job Description**


The Implementation Consultant II, RCM is a developing professional who plays a key role in helping customers successfully adopt and optimize revenue cycle management solutions. Working closely with customers and cross\-functional teams, this individual supports system configuration, workflow design, issue resolution, and implementation activities while building expertise in healthcare operations and revenue cycle processes. The ideal candidate is curious, adaptable, and forward\-thinking, with a passion for leveraging technology, automation, and AI\-enabled solutions to improve customer outcomes, drive operational efficiency, and support successful product adoption.

**What You'll Do**

* Support customer onboarding and implementation activities, ensuring a smooth transition to Ensora solutions.
* Configure billing rules, payer setup, and claim workflows to align with customer requirements and best practices.
* Partner with customers to understand current\-state workflows and recommend system configurations that support operational goals.
* Troubleshoot and resolve standard system and process issues, escalating more complex challenges when appropriate.
* Assist with the validation of claims and identification of rejections, denials, and processing errors.
* Document implementation activities, workflows, decisions, and system configurations.
* Communicate effectively with customers, project stakeholders, and internal teams to ensure alignment and progress throughout implementations.
* Monitor implementation milestones and support project deliverables to help ensure successful outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, streamline workflows, and enhance the customer experience.
* Utilize available technology, analytics, automation, and AI\-enabled tools to improve efficiency, support data\-driven decisions, and optimize implementation results.
* Stay current on industry trends, healthcare technology advancements, and revenue cycle best practices to support continuous improvement and innovation.

**What You'll Bring**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 2 or more years of experience.
* Experience with system implementation, revenue cycle management (RCM), or healthcare operations.
* Understanding of revenue cycle workflows and processes.
* Strong organizational and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

**Preferred Skills \& Experience**

* Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies, systems, and processes quickly.
* Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to analyze issues and determine appropriate actions.
* Detail\-oriented approach with a commitment to accuracy in system configuration, validation, and documentation.
* Proven problem\-solving skills and the ability to navigate implementation challenges effectively.
* Experience identifying opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency.
* Interest in leveraging technology, automation, and AI\-enabled solutions to solve business challenges and improve customer outcomes.
* A growth mindset with the ability to adapt to evolving systems, tools, and business needs.
**Additional Information**

jobs.description:
**About Shipwell**

At Shipwell, we empower supply chain efficiency and service effectiveness at scale. The Shipwell platform includes capabilities previously out of most shippers' technical reach and affordability today. Our solution combines everything shippers need, from transportation management and visibility to procurement, in a comprehensive, easy\-to\-use platform. It will adapt and scale as market and business demand change, allowing shippers to operate, manage, and optimize the shipping process seamlessly. Industry experts have recognized Shipwell's traction in the market and have differentiated Shipwell as a leader in the logistics industry. Awards include Gartner Magic Quadrant for Transportation Management Systems (TMS) 2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, Food Logistics’ 2024 Top Software \& Technology Providers, and FreightWaves’ FreightTech 2022 and 2021 Awards for Innovation and Disruption in Freight Industry. Shipwell was also named the fourth fastest\-growing company in North America in the 2021, 2022, and 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500 and Forbes 2020 Next Billion\-Dollar Startup.

**Our Culture**

Shipwell is a fast\-paced, high\-energy start\-up that strives to build the future of shipping every day. Diversity of thought and cross\-department collaboration is very important to us. We deliver open, honest, careful communication and work as hard as we play. We create \& deliver solutions that are revolutionizing the industry, which brings excitement and purpose to our work. If you are looking for a place that will help you tap into your best work\-self and give you hands\-on experience building something big, then we invite you to come and build the future of shipping with us!

**About the Role**

As the Implementation Consultant you will play a pivotal role in differentiating Shipwell during a critical time in the customer journey. As the Implementation Consultant, you will work with a team of Implementation Consultants, Solutions Engineers, Sales and Customer Support team members. You will be crucial to the success of the customer experience.

What you’ll do when you get here:

**Client Onboarding**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during the implementation phase.
* Build strong, professional relationships with client stakeholders at various levels.
* Understand client business needs and objectives to tailor the implementation approach.
* Guide clients through onboarding activities, ensuring a smooth and positive experience.

**Technical Implementation**

* ERP Integration experience to configure the TMS to meet client \- specific requirements.
* Ability to process map integration designs and showcase to customer
* Collaborate with internal technical teams (e.g., Engineering, Product) to resolve integration and technical challenges.
* Provide technical guidance and support to clients throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Test and validate configured solutions to ensure alignment with client requirements.

**Process Improvement**

* Identify areas for improvement in the implementation process and contribute to developing best practices.
* Document workflows, configuration steps, and implementation processes for internal and client\-facing use.
* Support the creation of internal tools, templates, and resources to enhance implementation efficiency.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver a seamless client experience.
* Share feedback and insights with Product teams based on client implementation outcomes.
* Ensure a smooth transition of clients to the Customer Success team after implementation.

**What you need to have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Proven experience in software implementation, consulting, or business analysis.
* Deep understanding of systems and operations with B2B products.
* A data\-driven approach to building, tracking, and optimizing performance metrics.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* Self\-motivated, detail\-attentive, and action\-driven, with the ability to take initiative, execute, and follow\-through.
* Highly effective communicator with strong interpersonal skills; able to build trust and work well with diverse teams inside and outside the company.
* Eager for a very hands\-on role in a dynamic environment.
* High integrity and enthusiasm for contributing to a company’s long\-term success.
* Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it.
* Familiarity with SaaS platforms, enterprise software, or logistics/transportation systems preferred.

**Why Shipwell:**

* Enjoy working remotely with the added perk of a home office reimbursement
* Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
* A robust healthcare package that includes medical, dental \& vision benefits, short\-term and long\-term disability, AD\&D coverage, and flexible/health savings accounts
* 401K program where Shipwell matches up to 4%
* Employee Stock Options
* A yearly learning and development budget
* Subsidized internet, cell phone, fitness, and educational reimbursements
* Virtual team\-building events where fun and connection take center stage
* Join a vibrant, inclusive workplace shaped by friendly, talented individuals
* Receive a technology package, including a MacBook Pro
* Employee Recognition Program to celebrate and incentivize hard work and success!

The salary range for this role is $95K\-$125K with potential variable upside.

Shipwell is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We celebrate diversity and believe that experience comes in different forms. Diversity in our team makes for better problem\-solving, more creative thinking, and ultimately, a better product and company culture.

Even more important than your resume is a clear demonstration of impact, dedication, and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced and collaborative environment. Shipwell strives to have an inclusive work environment; so if you are hard\-working \& good at what you do, then please come as you are. We want you to contribute, grow, \& learn at Shipwell.

We are looking forward to adding new perspectives to our team!

For more information about Shipwell visit shipwell.com, or connect with us on Twitter @shipwell, LinkedIn, and Facebook.com/Shipwellinc

jobs.description:
Description:
**About Birdeye**


Birdeye is the leading agentic marketing platform for multi\-location brands.


Companies like H\&R Block, Aspen Dental, and Caesars Entertainment use Birdeye to manage marketing across thousands of locations — from how they get found, to how they convert, to how they retain customers. Our platform replaces disconnected point tools with AI agents that execute work at the location level — responding to reviews, updating listings, publishing content, and driving conversions.


Backed by Marc Benioff, Jerry Yang, and Accel\-KKR, Birdeye was named to G2’s 2026 Best Agentic AI Products list — appearing alongside the world’s leading AI companies. We’re expanding rapidly into enterprise, with growing adoption across large, multi\-location brands.

**About the Role**


We are looking for a customer\-focused Implementation Specialist to own the end\-to\-end deployment of Birdeye's AI and voice solutions. This role will work closely with customers, IT teams, FDEs, Product, and Engineering to configure, test, and launch solutions successfully.


This is a customer\-facing implementation and configuration role, not a backend engineering role.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own implementations from kickoff through go\-live, including timelines, milestones, risks, and customer communication.
* Execute integration playbooks and coordinate EHR/PMS and third\-party integrations.
* Configure providers, appointment types, availability, widgets, knowledge bases, and other product settings.
* Configure AI agents, including workflows, procedures, prompts, guardrails, and customer\-specific business rules.
* Be comfortable understanding customer requirements and translating them into effective agent workflows and experiences.
* Coordinate telephony setup and call\-forwarding with customer IT/telephony teams.
* Lead UAT, end\-to\-end testing, go\-live, and post\-launch validation.
* Identify risks and technical dependencies early and coordinate resolution with FDE/Engineering.
* Maintain accurate implementation documentation and continuously improve implementation playbooks.
* Voice Agent Tuning: Continuously tune voice agent workflows, prompts, procedures, and guardrails based on customer requirements, UAT results, and real\-world call behavior to improve accuracy and customer experience.
* Post\-Launch Call Reviews: Conduct regular post\-launch call reviews to identify gaps, incorrect responses, workflow issues, and opportunities to improve

**What This Role Does NOT Own**

* Backend tooling or custom backend logic
* Building or modifying APIs or engineering tools
* Custom engineering/SOW development
* Backend security/compliance logic
* Engineering\-level debugging of backend tooling


These requirements will be identified and coordinated with FDE/Engineering, while


Implementation owns the customer communication, testing, and delivery.


Requirements:
**Qualifications**

* 3–7 years of SaaS implementation, technical onboarding, professional services, or similar experience.
* Strong project management and customer\-facing communication skills.
* Comfortable with integrations, workflows, APIs, and technical concepts.
* Comfortable configuring AI/voice agents and translating business requirements into agent workflows.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working with enterprise customers and cross\-functional technical teams.
* Ability to manage multiple implementations and drive projects to completion.

**Preferred**

* Experience with AI, conversational AI, voice, contact center, or telephony solutions.
* Experience with healthcare EHR/PMS platforms.
* Experience with UAT and enterprise go\-live processes.

**Why You’ll Join Us**


At Birdeye, we are relentless innovators driven by a singular goal: to lead our category with unparalleled excellence. We don't just set goals – we surpass them. We're a team of doers who roll up our sleeves and get the job done, delivering on our promises with unwavering dedication.


Working here means embracing a culture of action and accountability, where every person is empowered to make an impact. We don't just talk about making a difference – we make it happen.

**Benefits**

* 100% Employer\-paid benefit plans available for employees with multiple health plan options (HSA, PPO)
* Flexible PTO
* 401(k) with company match
* Flexible work from home options available
* Maternity \& Paternity Leave
* Employee Resource Groups \- network with like\-minded "Birds"
* Abundant opportunities that come with a dynamic and fast\-growing organization!

Always maintain CCHMC¿s service standards of being Courteous, Attentive, Respectful and Enthusiastic team members, and Safe (CARES).
  
  

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

jobs.title: Training Specialist II - Job #932
jobs.company: North Los Angeles County Regional Center
jobs.description:
**The Organization**


North Los Angeles County Regional Center “NLACRC” is a private, non\-profit agency that is contracted with the State of California, Department of Developmental Services, to provide services to individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities. NLACRC is one of the largest regional centers in California and has proudly served the San Fernando Valley, Santa Clarita Valley, and Antelope Valley since 1974\. We serve individuals across the lifespan from infants and toddlers, school age children, transition\-age youth, to adults and aging adults.

**Supervision**


Receives general supervision from the Training and Development Supervisor.

**The Position and Job Summary**


The Training Specialist II maintains training transcripts for staff in accordance with strategic initiatives set by the Training and Development Supervisor. They actively participate as a trainer in new hire training and other assigned trainings. They maintain all facets of the Learning Management System including, but not limited to user experience, automation, and programming of course enrollments, branding, and record management. Additionally, they serve as an instructional designer, provide recommendations, and prepare analysis for strategic reports to the Training and Development Supervisor.

**Employment Standards**


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

* Available as a resource for the Training Specialist I as it relates to coordination of NLACRC trainings with trainers and staff. Provides additional support as needed.
* Tracks NLACRC new staff progress through New Staff Orientation (NSO) learning paths and informs staff, supervisors and the Training and Development Supervisor as needed. Analyzes post\-survey data to provide recommendations for upgrades to NSO courses, programs, and systems.
* Participates as a trainer for NSO training protocols and other training initiatives as assigned by the Training and Development Supervisor.
* Maintains and updates the user interface for the Learning Management System (LMS) front\-end to improve staff experience. Collaborates with the LMS developer to resolve technical issues related to LMS efficiencies.
* Lead administrator of the LMS, training library, and various training platforms as assigned by the Training and Development Supervisor.
* Monitors and updates back\-end functions of various LMS systems, standard operating procedures of the Training Unit, and other training processes as assigned by the Training and Development Supervisor.
* Maintains and updates the training library to ensure accurate information, current materials, and representation/communication of all training initiatives.
* Acts as lead training specialist as it relates to the set up/breakdown of in\-person training classes, and coordinates with other departments to support as necessary and assigned by the Training and Development Supervisor.
* Provides recommendations and conference room setup options to the Training and Development Supervisor to optimize learner and facilitator/trainer experience for in\-person trainings.
* Participates as an instructional designer for subject matter experts (SMEs) throughout the agency utilizing all aspects of the ADDIE model (Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, Evaluation). Designs and develops eLearning and in\-person training as assigned by the Training and Development Supervisor.
* Sources external trainings as assigned by the Training and Development Supervisor.
* Maintains library of approved training designs, templates, procedures, materials and provides recommendations for optimizations to the Training and Development Supervisor.
* Creates annual or bi\-annual rollout schedule for all mandatory and Federal/State required trainings.
* Prepares and maintains monthly Key Performance Indicator (KPI) report by analyzing raw data.
* Prepares quarterly reports to support the strategic plan and performance contract requirements for submittal to the Training and Development Supervisor.
* Responsible for and ensures timely completion of NSO learning paths during the onboarding process for staff.
* Other projects as assigned. Overtime as needed.
* Performs additional duties a needed.

**Education and/or Experience**

* A Bachelor’s degree, preferred.
* 2 to 5 years of related training and LMS administrator experience.
* Instructional Design Certification.
* Training and Facilitation Certification or 2\- 5 years in training facilitation.

**Skills and Abilities**

* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint).
* Proficient working with eLearning software. Articulate 360, preferred.
* Proficient working with Adobe Creative Suite.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 10 lbs.

**Essential Requirements**


Valid California Driver’s License and reliable transportation, or acceptable substitute, required.

**NLACRC Offers an Excellent Benefits Package**


We offer employees a variety of health and dental plans:

* Health Insurance \- NLACRC pays the full cost of coverage for certain Medical plans for employee only. We also provide a generous contribution to additional plans that the employee may select for employee only or employee and dependents costs.
* Dental Insurance – NLACRC pays the full cost of the Dental DMO Plan for employees and eligible dependents. We also offer a Dental PPO plan with a low employee monthly contribution for employees and eligible dependents
* Pre\-Tax Flexible Spending Account for eligible health care expenses
* Pre\-Tax Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account for eligible dependent care expenses
* No cost Life, Accidental Death \& Disability, Long Term Disability Insurance for employees
* No cost Vision plan for employees and eligible dependents
* Retirement plan \- NLACRC is a member of CalPERS which is a defined benefit plan that provides a monthly retirement allowance for eligible employees
* NLACRC offers two (2\) deferred compensation plans \- 457 and 403(b)
* Participate in the Public Service Loan Forgiveness program
* Paid Time Off – Eligible for 3 weeks of accrued vacation in the first year, 8 hours per month sick time, education, wellness and sabbatical time
* Holidays – NLACRC offers 12 paid holidays throughout the year
* Most positions are offered a hybrid – remote option


Please note that benefit costs are pro\-rated for part\-time employees.

**Professional Development Opportunities \& Growth**


NLACRC values the professional development of staff! Many staff gain experience and enter into Supervisor, Manager or Director positions.

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**


At NLACRC, we value and celebrate diversity! In September 2021, NLACRC launched an initiative to enhance and strengthen our commitment to diversity and belonging.

**Compensation**


This position is non\-exempt, salaray range – $34\.73 to $49\.08


NLACRC is an equal opportunity employer. Further, NLACRC will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance
